title: The Mary's Tavern trio format
summary: Playing trumpet in a three-piece group with drums and piano after the war.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. And I played trumpet, just three pieces.
Just three pieces? Was that common at that time?
Oh yeah, for little jets like that. But they had good business there. I think the drinks was like twenty cents.
So this is after the war?
Yeah, I just got out of the service. That was the first job I had. The first regular job I had.
Just having piano, bass, I mean drums, and trumpet, how do you compensate for not having the other instruments?
Oh, well, just play. You know, the piano would give you your harmonic structure and you had the drum to keep the rhythm, and the trumpet would take the, just play a solo.
